scope: IntegerSieve追加の素数配列reserve見積りを比較
reason: 確保回数の削減を狙ったが、Clangの262144/1000000構築で最大約14%増。全範囲で効果を保てず、既存の自動拡張を維持。

measurement.method: 同プロセス31短batch、順序回転、通常allocator。入力準備外/構築破棄込み、CPU14/C++23-O2/SKIP。

reproduction.prepare.py:
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent;r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');header=(r/'Math/Zeta_Mebius.cpp').read_text();component=(r/'Math/Zeta/components/sieve.inc').read_text();(p/'baseline.hpp').write_text(header);(p/'baseline.inc').write_text(component);(p/'control.inc').write_text(component)
for name,minimum,den in [('reserve_width',256,'std::bit_width(limit - 1)'),('reserve_width1',2048,'std::bit_width(limit - 1) + 1')]:
 code=component.replace('        const std::size_t limit = least_prime_factor.size();','        const std::size_t limit = least_prime_factor.size();\n        if (limit - 1 >= '+str(minimum)+') prime_list.reserve(2 * (limit - 1) / ('+den+'));',1);(p/(name+'.inc')).write_text(code)
s='#include "'+str(p/'baseline.hpp')+'"\n'
for name in ['control','reserve_width','reserve_width1']:
 s+='#undef SIRKIT_INTEGER_SIEVE_DEFINED\n#define IntegerSieve Sieve_'+name+'\n#include "'+str(p/(name+'.inc'))+'"\n#undef IntegerSieve\n'
(p/'combined.hpp').write_text(s)
